archetypes.name: dyn-step5-contract
archetypes.rationale: Step 5 prose compression must not drop rare publish and OOS recovery branches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the finalize-step5.md compression for semantic drift in Step 5b OOS filing, Step 5b.5 diagram handling, and Step 5c publish outcomes. Focus on whether any machine tokens, sentinel semantics, or abort/continue branches changed despite the prose shrink. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
